changed_dimension: Known reference passages replace normal top-five context, only for diagnosis. Prompts, model, schema, token budget and review criteria remain unchanged.
course_source: 04-evaluation separates retrieval and final-answer evaluation; exact-reference-context injection is a project diagnostic adaptation, never an application retrieval algorithm.
hypothesis: If complete answers appear with only the exact supporting passages, distractor/context handling is implicated. If they still fail, improve generation/output handling rather than blaming reference ranking.
acceptance: Read all four raw outputs against their actual reference passages and frozen facts. Diagnosis may change the next engineering action but cannot select a winner or earn retrieval/heldout-quality credit.
accounting_fix: Diagnostic now retains all completed invalid outputs instead of stopping at the first one; actual infrastructure errors still stop. All attempts are counted. Prompt and model behavior were not changed by this bookkeeping correction.
heldout_exposure: Development diagnostic only; selected evidence contains reference IDs by design, so it is oracle-context evidence and never a blind test.
next_action: Test plain-text context serialization, preserving all source fields and the unchanged answer contract. Do not count this oracle-context diagnostic as retrieval or full-development quality evidence.
finding: Neither prompt produces a complete supported answer even with only known supporting passages. Retrieval noise alone cannot explain these failures; temporal interpretation, reading the second source passage and citation-format following remain problematic.
